name: Throw Lucky Blocks for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Throw Lucky Blocks! 🎲

💪 Throw your Lucky Block as far as you can for better rewards!
🍀 The further it lands, the higher your luck!
🚨 Guards will try to steal your Lucky Block… don’t get caught!
🏃 Run back to your base safely to secure your rewards!
💸 Collect Brainrots to earn cash and upgrade your power!

💤 Your Brainrots earn cash even while you're offline!

💎 PREMIUM PLAYERS GET +10% CASH
